address: Saint Geraldu, St Paul's Bay, SPB 3310, Malta
bio: LOA’s extensive terrace, bathed in sunshine, sets the scene for a truly memorable dining experience in a casual, stylish vibe against a panorama of drop-dead views. The high-flying lineup stars a vibrant journey into South American fusion cuisine that is expressive, creative and packed in personality. The menu celebrates the rich diversity of this culinary universe, featuring dishes inspired by the traditions of Argentina, Chile, Peru, Mexico and beyond. To complete the experience, LOA offers an excellent selection of pre-dinner cocktails, expertly crafted and perfect for easing into the evening in style....
